letter_deductions.deduction: Less: Cataract limit (right eye), balance available INR 7,500.00
letter_deductions.why: Clause 4.3 limit is per eye: right eye has the full 37,500; the 30,000 used was for the left eye. 54,700 - 37,500 = 17,200.
Method right (Clause 9.3) but on the wrong 7,500 base; 5% of 37,500 = 1,875.

notes: Insurer netted the left-eye claim against the right-eye cataract limit; Clause 4.3 says "per each eye in one policy year". SI remaining (1,50,000 less 28,500 paid or 30,000 admitted) is not binding.
